List all files in the logs directory.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to see files in the logs directory. I'll use fs.list to retrieve them.</reasoning>
<tool>fs.list</tool>
<path>logs</path>
</action>

<action>

<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>The logs directory contains 3 files: app.log, error.log, and access.log.</content>
</action>
Create a note titled 'API Key Rotation' with the content 'Rotate production keys by EOD Friday.'

Search my memory for the vendor contact from the 1998 offsite retreat.

<action>
<reasoning>The user is looking for a very old memory entry. I'll search the memory index for relevant records.</reasoning>
<tool>memory.search</tool>
<query>1998 offsite retreat vendor contact</query>
</action>

<action>
